_comment: Where each district's ADOPTED policy manual actually lives. Every district here is on the NYSSBA policy service, but the manual is served by a third-party portal — NOT by BoardDocs (whose BD-GetPolicies API returns 'No Access' anonymously) and NOT by the district website (which links only a handful of loose PDFs). boardpolicyonline.com is a Blazor Server app with no fetchable API, so herald.scrape.policy_manual drives it in a real browser and uses its own bulk export; see .github/workflows/policy-fetch.yml. A slug is confirmed by the shell size: a live book returns ~5 KB, an unknown slug returns 37 bytes. Ossining and Elmsford have migrated off the legacy MicroScribe Folio infobase onto the same v3 portal (MicroScribe Publishing Inc runs both). 'discover_from' is a district page known to link the portal, for districts whose portal we haven't pinned yet; the probe follows it.

boardpolicyonline.note: Legacy ?b=<slug> redirects to v3.boardpolicyonline.com/b/<slug>. Section deep links are /b/<slug>/s/<section_id> (the export's div ids). Blazor Server: no REST API, needs a browser.

microscribe.note: Folio infobase served through om_isapi.dll; depth/softpage params drive the tree.
